items.question: Are mothers tormented in eighty-four thousand womb diagrams?
premises: Mothers are tormented in womb diagrams.
items.inference: Thus mothers suffer in eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: Exact gender and referent of pīḍitāḥ uncertain.
Context of khecaris and bhūcaris not fully explicit.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
